description: Angular component for displaying and editing entity details in Thingsboard UI, including tab management, form handling, and entity data operations.

classes.name: EntityDetailsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing entity details panel, including loading, editing, and tab management.

methods.name: reloadEntity
methods.description: Loads entity data based on current entity ID.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Saves the current entity form data, handling conflicts and updates.

methods.name: buildEntityTabsComponent
methods.description: Constructs the entity tabs component dynamically.

methods.name: onCloseEntityDetails
methods.description: Emits event to close the entity details panel.

methods.name: onToggleEditMode
methods.description: Switches between view and edit modes for the entity.

methods.name: helpLinkId
methods.description: Generates help link ID based on entity form.
